subject: full data database access
body:
Hi Nora,

Glad to hear that your previous question is resolved.

Regarding compliance, there are multiple ways you can check.

First, in the Participation page (left panel, click on Participation), you can see the list of participants, % of sensor data uploaded, and % of surveys completed considering all surveys that are responded.

Also, in Activity Sessions page, you can check the % of completion per survey. Here you can also see the exact sessions that are completed or missed or any reason.

Lastly, you can export the data of any of these pages, and import them to any software (Spreadsheets or R for example) and plot it as you need.

Hope it helps,
Mohammad

Dear Nora,
